10.title: Stage 10: stub diameter x2 (total held), x2 (density held), x4 (total held); ramps 1.1/11/110 pA/ms and the 310 pA step
10.prediction: x4: the somatic spike-1 take-off falls by more than 1 mV from the slowest to the fastest ramp and the axon[1] lead is below 0.15 ms. x2, both arms: the somatic take-off falls by more than 0.5 mV and the two arms agree within 0.5 mV (the slide follows the coupling, not the density). Somatic onset span stays within 3.5 to 5.7 mV; the 310 pA count stays within 2 of 10.
10.rejection: No spike on a ramp or on the step at a dose: no reading at that dose. A slide with the onset span outside 3.5 to 5.7 mV: the coupling changed the spike, not only its reading. The x2 arms disagreeing by more than 0.5 mV: density, not coupling, is acting.
